text: In regions where betel nut is popular, individuals belonging to the cultural group of Betel Nut chewers are commonly observed engaging in the practice of chewing and grinding betel nut with substances like coral and chalk to achieve desired effects. This behavior is accompanied by a focus on dental hygiene to preserve gums and teeth, as well as to enhance the chewing experience. It is noteworthy that the use of betel nut can have effects on the skin, requiring the application of acid for removal. Within the sampled population, a significant portion regards this behavior as a standard practice within the cultural group.
